highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and ships compiler XML documentation with the NuGet packages.
highlights_body: API documentation now travels beside the managed assemblies, while HarfBuzzSharp binding generation follows the native source pinned by Skia.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is renamed
breaking.body: The corrected upstream member is now named UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132, retaining numeric value 132. Update source references to CCC133 before upgrading.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer available
breaking.body: HarfBuzzSharp no longer exposes aggregate *_DEFINED mask constants. Replace GlyphFlags.Defined with the concrete flags your application needs combined explicitly.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates upstream m154 bug fixes and a buffer upload correction.

bullets.lead: Compiler XML documentation ships with packages
bullets.detail: NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation beside managed assemblies, making API documentation available directly to IDE consumers.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Scoped native compiler-warning suppressions for the HarfBuzzSharp package build

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 renderer for early package validation.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp bindings are now generated from Skia's pinned native source, keeping existing supported APIs synchronized with HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces Skia m154 and package XML documentation.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It also aligns HarfBuzzSharp binding generation with the bundled native source.
